dialogue.htmlContent:
As you travel through a quiet stretch of the Foloi Fields, you notice a well-worn dirt track branching off from the main path. Following it with your eyes, you spot a collection of rustic wooden buildings nestled in a sheltered valley, surrounded by white-fenced paddocks.

The unmistakable sound of horses whinnying carries on the breeze, and as you draw closer, you can make out a large, hand-painted sign swinging gently above the main gate: [style.boldGood(Sally's Stables)].

It appears to be a well-established horse ranch, and from the general state of the place, it looks like it's been here for quite some time. You make a mental note of this location for future reference...
